jobs.title: Senior AI Artist
jobs.description:
At AKQA (part of WPP), we believe in the imaginative application of art and the relentless pursuit of craft. We design experiences, products, and communications that captivate audiences and create enduring value for the world’s most ambitious brands. Embracing curiosity, invention, and collaboration, we welcome forward-thinking creators who are excited by the frontier of technology and visual storytelling.

As a generative Senior AI Artist at AKQA, you will stand at the intersection of creative imagination and cutting-edge technology. You will champion the craft of AI-generated visual media, translating nuanced creative direction into striking, campaign-grade imagery while expanding our capabilities into next-generation AI video production.

Working with Google tools and applications alongside the broader generative AI ecosystem, you will take ownership of the generation, refinement, and post-production of client-ready assets. Collaborating closely with Creative Directors, Art Directors, and multidisciplinary project teams, you will guide visual feasibility, push aesthetic boundaries, and establish best-in-class generative workflows.

Role Requirements

Own Image Generation & Finishing: Lead the end-to-end production of complex AI-generated campaign visuals from concepting and prompt engineering through to iteration, compositing, and final polish.
Champion Video Exploration: Actively contribute to AI video production across all stages, including reference gathering, storyboarding, generation, motion consistency, upscaling, and post-production finishing.
Translate Creative Vision: Partner with Associate Creative Directors and Creative Directors to interpret visual references, briefs, and brand guidelines into compelling, aesthetically refined outputs.
Ensure Fidelity and Brand Accuracy: Scrutinise subject likeness, product accuracy, lighting, environment, and textures to deliver near-final, campaign-ready fidelity during client review stages.
Bridge Tech & Creativity: Serve as an informed voice on generative possibilities and constraints, clearly communicating workflows, limitations, and alternative creative solutions to internal teams and clients.
Refine and Retouch: Apply traditional visual craft and post-production techniques (compositing, retouching, colour grading) to ensure outputs meet AKQA’s benchmark for visual excellence.
Experiment and Share: Continually explore, benchmark, and stress-test emerging image and video models, node-based workflows, and creative tooling, actively sharing insights across the studio.

Qualities & Characteristics

Exceptional Aesthetic Craft: A distinguished eye for composition, cinematic lighting, material realism, perspective, and fine detail, substantiated by an outstanding portfolio of generative work.
Generative Fluency: Deep, hands-on experience across state-of-the-art AI image platforms, with demonstrated experience in Google’s generative AI ecosystem and wider production tools.
Motion & Video Acumen: A keen understanding of high-quality video fundamentals: motion coherence, camera movement, temporal consistency, pacing, and continuity.
Technical Versatility: Familiarity with node-based generation workflows (e.g., ComfyUI), advanced high-resolution upscaling, and traditional post-production tools (Adobe Photoshop, Premiere Pro, After Effects).
Craft in Ambiguity: Agile and inventive when problem-solving generative quirks, visual artefacts, and rapid iteration cycles within deadline-driven campaign environments.
Collaborative Communicator: Receptive to creative feedback, articulate in explaining generative nuances to non-technical stakeholders, and eager to elevate the collective standard of the team.
Relentless Curiosity: A self-starter mindset with an appetite to learn, rapidly test new models, and shape the evolving language of AI-driven art direction.

This isn’t another content job.

Every day, on every platform, in French and in English. You bring the taste. The machine you build brings the scale.

Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. We aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents.

What Ai-native Content Means At Paradox 🤖

Paradoxically, the more AI runs our content, the more human it has to feel. AI doesn’t make more of what everyone makes. It makes more of what only we can make.

Our Creative Machine Has To Be Able To

Read the signals. Comments, DMs, retention graphs, saves, shares, search trends, objections from sales calls, and what the best creators and advertisers in the world are publishing right now.
Hold the full context of Paradox. Our DNA, years of interviews, lives and courses, member stories, and every past post with what it taught us, in one shared company brain.

OUR MISSION

At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable, and we believe self-help is broken.

Most learning platforms are used the same way: consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

People deserve more: a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We Do That By Merging

Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

You lead the Content Factory not by management, but with creativity.

Your goal is to produce content that is so good, unique, and aligned with our values that people would cry if they had to unsubscribe.

In a classic content team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the volume, you design the machine, set the bar and make the calls. Humans do what no machine can: taste.

you spend your time on concepts, taste and calls, not on resizing, captioning and exporting. The output grows every month while the team doesn’t.

Help us market a product that fuses neuroscience, design, and AI to reinvent how humans grow.

Build one of the first truly AI-native media, and write the playbook others will copy.

Description

Amazon’s Brand Innovation Lab is looking for a talented, passionate, and a hands-on Creative (Art Director) to conceptualise and create one-of-a-kind campaigns for a wide range of brands across MENA. You’ll partner with Sales leads, Solutions Managers, Producers, and Design Technology and Engineering teams to create first-class customer experiences both online and offline by innovating with the Amazon canvas (Prime Video, Alexa, Twitch, etc.). You’ll lead projects and own client relationships, focusing on creating work that benefits the end customer while pushing the creative envelope from brief to execution, with a focus on our partnerships and sponsorships offering.

From ideation through launch, you will be responsible for delivering ambitious, insightful, and data-driven concepts that translate needs and constraints into customer-focused brand campaign ideas and solutions. You will be equally strong at concept and execution and an expert in leveraging AI tools and workflows, articulating end-to-end creative solutions, and turning that vision into high-quality experiences. This could include video content, user interface designs for voice and screen, interaction models, prototypes, and interactive advertising campaigns. This role will use data and insights to create campaign strategy and concepts, develop designs and the look and feel for experiences, as well as templates for never-before-done brand campaigns and experiences that will solve customer problems, on and off Amazon platforms.

Candidates should have an in-depth understanding of AI tools, Photoshop, Illustrator, PowerPoint, Figma and Webflow, (or an interest to learn Webflow), and understanding of UX design.

The candidate’s portfolio should feature highly creative, award-winning campaigns and ideas that solve customer and advertiser problems through a variety of different media channels, including but not limited to video, social, digital activations, and outdoor. You have strong conceptual, presentation, storytelling, and time management skills, as well as digital media experience, insight-driven and strategic thinking, and of course, an acute attention to detail.

Key job responsibilities

Concept, design (art), and execute innovative ad campaigns and experiences for global brands.

Partner with designers, program managers, developers, strategists, business leads, and producers to create customer-focused solutions that deliver on advertiser objectives.

Independently lead campaigns from brief to execution and collaborate with internal teams, clients, and external agency partners.
Obsessed with understanding customers and making work that delivers both innovation and results.
Present ideas and concepts to clients, agencies, and internally.
Proven ability to ideate for film, print, digital, out-of-home, experiential, and social.
Ability to manage multiple projects at once within budget and deadlines.
Be proactive in developing new products and ideas on behalf of the customer.

A day in the life

Partnering with a variety of brands, media, and creative agencies to work on innovative campaigns for travel and tourism, automotive, finance, consumables, telecommunication etc.
From designing brand experiences (digital and physical), from documentary films in Prime Video to Alexa branded experiences, you will always strive to create never-before-done ideas.
Presenting a campaign to senior brand clients and their partners in creative and media agencies.
Reviewing edits and work in progress with your partners, collecting and responding to feedback in order to meet the highest creative standards.
Work with your team on proactive projects and initiatives and bring them to life.

About The Team

The Brand Innovation Lab is Amazon' Ads Innovation team dedicated to creating one-of-a-kind campaigns and activations for global advertisers.

Leveraging the full Amazon canvas: custom landing pages, Alexa, Fire TV, Twitch, Prime Video, and more. We build campaigns that reach millions of customers across digital channels and in the real world.

The team also works on Prime Video IP and brands, developing co-branded full-funnel campaigns.

Basic Qualifications

Experience in driving compelling creative strategy and execution at an agency or in-house creative team
Experience communicating and delivering presentations to customers, stakeholders, and/or teammates
In-depth understanding of industry design tools (Ex. Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma), and a basic understanding of UX design and UX design Tools (ie. Webflow)

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator, Keynote
Experience developing cross-functional relationships with product, consumer research and marketing teams to develop strategy and consumer insights that drive compelling creative executions
Experience leading creative development of innovative creative from concept to delivery
Experience presenting creative concepts effectively to senior executives
Experience managing multiple projects and meeting aggressive deadlines
Experience in developing creative concepts and executing campaigns for brand partnerships and/or sponsorships

Every day, on every platform, in French and in English. You bring the taste. The machine you build brings the scale.

Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. We aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents.

What Ai-native Content Means At Paradox 🤖

Paradoxically, the more AI runs our content, the more human it has to feel. AI doesn’t make more of what everyone makes. It makes more of what only we can make.

Our Creative Machine Has To Be Able To

Read the signals. Comments, DMs, retention graphs, saves, shares, search trends, objections from sales calls, and what the best creators and advertisers in the world are publishing right now.
Hold the full context of Paradox. Our DNA, years of interviews, lives and courses, member stories, and every past post with what it taught us, in one shared company brain.
Generate in our voice. Hooks, scripts, shorts, carousels, cuts, thumbnails and captions, in French and in English.
Ship. Format, schedule, publish and answer, on every platform.
Measure with real KPIs. Retention, shares, saves, follower growth, and the followers who become leads and members. Not likes.
Learn and loop on its own. Double down on what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content and wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.

OUR MISSION

At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable, and we believe self-help is broken.

Most learning platforms are used the same way: consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

People deserve more: a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We Do That By Merging

Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

Short history

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.

YOUR MISSION 🚀

You lead the Content Factory not by management, but with creativity.

Your goal is to produce content that is so good, unique, and aligned with our values that people would cry if they had to unsubscribe.

In a classic content team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the volume, you design the machine, set the bar and make the calls. Humans do what no machine can: taste.

🎯 YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS

Architect the "Dual-Brand" Strategy
Build a symbiotic strategy where David Laroche’s personal brand and Paradox’s company brand reinforce each other without cannibalization.
Implement radical new formats (documentaries, conceptual shorts) that shatter the boring codes of the "Self-Help" industry.
Define distinct, sharp editorial lines for each platform: Depth & Search for YouTube, Aesthetic & Vibe for Instagram, and Authority & Authenticity for LinkedIn.
❌ The old way: a strategy deck written once a year, and a calendar filled by habit.
🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents watch every platform, every competitor and every comment continuously. They tell you which angle is rising, which format is tiring and which story our audience asks for. The strategy updates every week, on evidence.
Radical Concepting & End-to-End Delivery
Take responsibility for the entire production chain from hooks to storyboarding the narrative, and ensuring the final cut matches the vision.
Own the packaging: titles, thumbnails and the first 3 seconds. You test variants every week and know your click-through and retention numbers by heart.
Deliver what you pitch.
❌ The old way: one shoot becomes one video and a handful of posts.
🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: one shoot, one live or one interview becomes dozens of hooks, shorts, carousels and ad cuts by the next morning, in both languages. Concepts are tested with AI-generated drafts before we spend a day shooting them.
Build the Content Factory: humans and agents
Your taste becomes the eval. You write down what makes a great hook, a great cut, a great carousel and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
Act as the final quality check: nothing gets published if it doesn’t meet the "Paradox Standard" of aesthetics and storytelling, whether a person or an agent made it.
❌ The old way: a creative team briefs an editor, waits three days and gets two versions.
🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents draft, cut, caption, translate and schedule. You keep the best, and next week their first drafts are already closer to your bar.
Fuel the Growth Engine
Analyze retention graphs, CTR, and CPL to iterate based on feedback, killing what fails and aggressively scaling what works.
❌ The old way: someone pulls the stats at the end of the month and nobody changes anything.
🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents read the numbers of every post every day, explain why it worked or didn’t, and propose the next test. You measure the machine itself: posts per week, time from idea to live, hit rate, and the share of the work done without a human.
Go global, and keep the soul
We started in French. You build the machine that takes Paradox to English-speaking audiences: channels, formats and voice that feel native, not translated.
And always: real stories told with consent, no fake claims, no fake scarcity. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.

How you’ll know you’re AI-native:
you spend your time on concepts, taste and calls, not on resizing, captioning and exporting. The output grows every month while the team doesn’t.

THE IDEAL AI NATIVE CANDIDATE 😍

Experience

Proven Content Builder: You have successfully grown a media brand, a YouTube channel, or a personal brand to significant scale (100k+ followers or millions of views). You understand the mechanics of virality and retention. You’ve created at least one format that broke out, and you can show its click-through and retention numbers.
Elite Scripting Skills: You can show us scripts you wrote that performed. You know how to structure a narrative, write a hook that stops the scroll, and keep an audience engaged for 20+ minutes.

AI-native Creative: you’ve built content pipelines with AI yourself: Claude Code, automations, generative video, image and voice tools, evals. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

Traits :

Intolerant to Mediocrity: You have "Taste." You are physically pained by a bad font, a clumsy cut, or a weak headline. You fight for the details that others ignore, including in what AI produces.
Psychology Obsessed: You don’t just "make content"; you study human nature. You constantly ask why people click, why they share, and what emotion drives them.

WHY JOIN US ❤️

jobs.description:
What if your next playground was to build a global, iconic Brand, with a creative machine that never sleeps, and compounds?

Then you’ll love this.

We’re not looking for a "Social Media Manager" to follow a calendar. We’re looking for an AI-native Creative Strategist (Brand & Content).

Someone who understands that to win today, you don’t just need "content", you need a Movement.

This isn’t another content job.
Most content teams use AI to write captions faster. That’s the 99%. We want to be in the 0.1%: a media where AI runs the creative loop, from the signal to the hook, the cut, the post and the lesson. Every day, on every platform, in French and in English. You bring the taste. The machine you build brings the scale.

Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. We aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents.

What Ai-native Content Means At Paradox 🤖

Paradoxically, the more AI runs our content, the more human it has to feel. AI doesn’t make more of what everyone makes. It makes more of what only we can make.

Our creative machine has to be able to:

Read the signals. Comments, DMs, retention graphs, saves, shares, search trends, objections from sales calls, and what the best creators and advertisers in the world are publishing right now.
Hold the full context of Paradox. Our DNA, years of interviews, lives and courses, member stories, and every past post with what it taught us, in one shared company brain.
Generate in our voice. Hooks, scripts, shorts, carousels, cuts, thumbnails and captions, in French and in English.
Ship. Format, schedule, publish and answer, on every platform.
Measure with real KPIs. Retention, shares, saves, follower growth, and the followers who become leads and members. Not likes.
Learn and loop on its own. Double down on what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content and wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.

OUR MISSION

At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable, and we believe self-help is broken.

Most learning platforms are used the same way: consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

People deserve more: a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We do that by merging:

Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

Short history

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.

YOUR MISSION 🚀

You lead the Content Factory not by management, but with creativity.

Your goal is to produce content that is so good, unique, and aligned with our values that people would cry if they had to unsubscribe.

In a classic content team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the volume, you design the machine, set the bar and make the calls. Humans do what no machine can: taste.

🎯 YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS

Architect the "Dual-Brand" Strategy
Build a symbiotic strategy where David Laroche’s personal brand and Paradox’s company brand reinforce each other without cannibalization.
Implement radical new formats (documentaries, conceptual shorts) that shatter the boring codes of the "Self-Help" industry.
Define distinct, sharp editorial lines for each platform: Depth & Search for YouTube, Aesthetic & Vibe for Instagram, and Authority & Authenticity for LinkedIn.
❌ The old way: a strategy deck written once a year, and a calendar filled by habit.
🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents watch every platform, every competitor and every comment continuously. They tell you which angle is rising, which format is tiring and which story our audience asks for. The strategy updates every week, on evidence.
Radical Concepting & End-to-End Delivery
Take responsibility for the entire production chain from hooks to storyboarding the narrative, and ensuring the final cut matches the vision.
Own the packaging: titles, thumbnails and the first 3 seconds. You test variants every week and know your click-through and retention numbers by heart.
Deliver what you pitch.
❌ The old way: one shoot becomes one video and a handful of posts.
🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: one shoot, one live or one interview becomes dozens of hooks, shorts, carousels and ad cuts by the next morning, in both languages. Concepts are tested with AI-generated drafts before we spend a day shooting them.
Build the Content Factory: humans and agents
Your taste becomes the eval. You write down what makes a great hook, a great cut, a great carousel and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
Act as the final quality check: nothing gets published if it doesn’t meet the "Paradox Standard" of aesthetics and storytelling, whether a person or an agent made it.
❌ The old way: a creative team briefs an editor, waits three days and gets two versions.
🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents draft, cut, caption, translate and schedule. You keep the best, and next week their first drafts are already closer to your bar.
Fuel the Growth Engine
Analyze retention graphs, CTR, and CPL to iterate based on feedback, killing what fails and aggressively scaling what works.
❌ The old way: someone pulls the stats at the end of the month and nobody changes anything.
🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents read the numbers of every post every day, explain why it worked or didn’t, and propose the next test. You measure the machine itself: posts per week, time from idea to live, hit rate, and the share of the work done without a human.
Go global, and keep the soul
We started in French. You build the machine that takes Paradox to English-speaking audiences: channels, formats and voice that feel native, not translated.
And always: real stories told with consent, no fake claims, no fake scarcity. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.

How you’ll know you’re AI-native:
you spend your time on concepts, taste and calls, not on resizing, captioning and exporting. The output grows every month while the team doesn’t.

THE IDEAL AI NATIVE CANDIDATE 😍

Experience :

Proven Content Builder: You have successfully grown a media brand, a YouTube channel, or a personal brand to significant scale (100k+ followers or millions of views). You understand the mechanics of virality and retention. You’ve created at least one format that broke out, and you can show its click-through and retention numbers.
Elite Scripting Skills: You can show us scripts you wrote that performed. You know how to structure a narrative, write a hook that stops the scroll, and keep an audience engaged for 20+ minutes.
Performance Fluency: You have worked in environments where content had to drive business results (ads, launches, conversion), not just vanity metrics.
AI-native Creative: you’ve built content pipelines with AI yourself: Claude Code, automations, generative video, image and voice tools, evals. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

Traits :

Intolerant to Mediocrity: You have "Taste." You are physically pained by a bad font, a clumsy cut, or a weak headline. You fight for the details that others ignore, including in what AI produces.
Psychology Obsessed: You don’t just "make content"; you study human nature. You constantly ask why people click, why they share, and what emotion drives them.
A "Doer" with Authority: You command respect not by title, but by competence. You can jump into a project, write the script, direct the shoot, and fix the edit if needed.
Loop thinker: you see every platform as a loop that can learn, and you can’t stop yourself from closing it.
No Ego, Just Impact: You don’t fall in love with your ideas. You accept that even the best concepts can flop. When it happens, you don’t take it personally; you analyze the data, pivot immediately, and ship the next concept with renewed energy.

Language

English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU

❌ If you prefer balance over intensity: wrong season.

❌ If you don’t genuinely care about the topics we cover: wrong place.

❌ If you want to strategize without getting your hands dirty in scripting, directing, or the editing suite: wrong role.

❌ If you think AI content means generic content: wrong role. We use AI to multiply what only we can make.

WHY JOIN US ❤️

Help us market a product that fuses neuroscience, design, and AI to reinvent how humans grow.

Build one of the first truly AI-native media, and write the playbook others will copy.

At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable, and we believe self-help is broken.

Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)

Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

Docplanner's Paid Marketing team - a B2B function focused on acquiring doctors and clinics - is looking for a Senior Specialist in Creative Strategy & Performance to own the full creative lifecycle for paid media: from strategy and briefing, through asset production management, to performance intelligence and testing. This is a hybrid strategist/operator role - half creative thinking, half process and data discipline.

You'll be the bridge between performance data and creative output - turning what's working (and what isn't) across our nine markets into sharper briefs, faster production cycles, and a continuously improving testing roadmap.

We are looking for a person with a Performance Marketing background that has hands-on experience in campaigns management and targets delivery. If you are a performance marketer who loves testing and can turn insights into repeatable creative performance, read on!

How will you make an impact?

Creative Strategy

Define the creative strategy and testing roadmap for paid campaigns across all markets and ad platforms, aligned with performance goals
Translate campaign objectives and audience insights into clear, actionable briefs
Partner with local market teams to adapt global creative direction to local nuances - language, culture, and regulatory requirements

Asset Preparation & Coordination

Own the end-to-end production workflow: brief - content and design coordination - review - localization - trafficking
Coordinate with in-house designers and freelancers to keep timelines predictable
Build and maintain a repeatable process - briefing templates, naming conventions, approval workflows - to reduce bottlenecks and rework

Creative Intelligence & Testing

Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across Meta and other paid channels, defining hypotheses, success metrics, and test cadence
Build creative performance reporting (Meta Ads, Tableau, Amplitude) that identifies which elements - format, hook, messaging, visual style - drive results
Maintain a creative intelligence repository documenting what's worked, by market and format, to inform future briefs

Tracking & Measurement

Ensure creative-level tracking is implemented and tagged correctly, in partnership with the tracking/tech team, so performance can be attributed accurately
Monitor creative fatigue and flag refresh cycles proactively, before performance declines

Team Flexibility

Step into hands-on campaign management when needed - covering colleagues' absences or supporting new market initiatives.

What We're Looking For

4+ years in performance marketing with a proven track record in creative strategy, or a media buying background with hands-on experience in paid social creative (Meta Ads required; TikTok, Google, LinkedIn, or Bing a plus)
Hands-on experience in paid media performance, including campaign set-up and management - able to step into hands-on campaign management when team capacity is stretched
Demonstrated experience managing creative production across multiple stakeholders - designers, agencies, local teams - at scale
Strong analytical skills - comfortable pulling and interpreting creative performance data independently, not relying on assumptions
Experience designing and running structured creative tests, not ad hoc experimentation
Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills - this role touches Paid Ads, Design, Local Marketing, and Data Analytics teams
Fluent English required; Spanish and/or Portuguese a strong plus given our market footprint
Comfortable operating across multiple markets and cultures simultaneously

Nice to Have

Familiarity with Amplitude, Tableau, or HubSpot or Creative Intelligence tools
Experience with creative automation or dynamic creative optimization (DCO) tools
Background in healthcare, marketplace, or subscription business models

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

– A first call with our Talent Partner, to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣TestGorilla –
(SHL numerical reasoning assessment).

– A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with the hiring manager and your potential manager in this role .
Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

5️⃣ Additional/ Final Interview (Optional)
– A final conversation with another senior leader from our Global Team.

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits –
No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:

Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.

Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth –
We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

we're here to make an impact.

take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean –
smart solutions over complexity.

openness builds trust.

growth is part of the job.

jobs.description:
As one of Europe’s most recognized streetwear brands, 6PM stands out not only through our designs and unique vibe, but above all through our community. Whether it’s pop-up tours, our own record label, or collaborations – we don’t just make fashion. We create culture.
And now, we’re looking for you!
The role holder plans and delivers 6PM's content productions — campaign and seasonal shoots, e-com assets and social content (to an extent) — and manages the freelancers, crews and suppliers required for them. Concept and visual language are owned by Brand. This role is accountable for feasibility, cost, resourcing, scheduling, rights compliance and on-time delivery of finished assets.
The role also runs the in-house studio and owns the production equipment inventory, so that recurring content can be produced internally at predictable cost and quality.
Tasks

Planning and pre-production

Translate creative concepts from Brand into production plans, schedules and budgets, including feasibility feedback at concept stage.

Source and book crew: photographers, directors, DoPs, stylists, hair and make-up, set designers, production assistants.

Run casting and talent booking with agencies, and scout, secure and contract locations and studios.

Organise equipment, catering, transport, permits for shoot locations where required, and all call sheets and shoot documentation.

Production

Run shoots on the day: schedule, crew, talent, client and stakeholder presence on set.

Ensure the agreed shot list and asset requirements per channel are covered before wrap.

Maintain duty of care on set: crew working hours, equipment and rigging safety, rules for minors on set, insurance cover.

Resolve issues on set and decide on schedule or scope changes within the approved budget.

Post-production and delivery

Manage post through edit, grade, retouch, sound and versioning, including briefing and steering post houses and freelancers.

Deliver finished assets in the formats, ratios and deadlines required by each channel.

Maintain asset organisation and handover so material is findable and reusable, including archive and metadata discipline.

Rights and compliance

Manage usage rights, buyouts, model and location releases, and music licensing.

Maintain the record of what is licensed, for which territories and channels, and for how long, and flag expiries before they bite.

Operations and partner management

Maintain the content production calendar with milestones and lead times, and feed it into the marketing calendar.

Build and maintain the freelancer, studio and supplier bench, including rate cards and framework agreements.

Control production budgets, track committed versus actual spend, and report variances to the Brand & Marketing Team.

In-house studio and equipment

Run day-to-day operation of the in-house studio: booking and scheduling across Marketing, Brand and E-commerce, set-up and reset between productions, and ordering studio stock and consumables.

Own the equipment inventory — cameras, lenses, lighting, grip, audio, computers and storage — including what we hold, where it is and who has it out.

Keep equipment production-ready: cleaning, calibration, firmware, repairs, warranty and insurance claims, and replacement of damaged kit.

Plan equipment investment against production needs, recommend purchases, and decide rent versus buy per production.

Requirements

Essential

4 to 6 years in content production, agency or brand side, with photo and film experience.

Has independently produced campaign shoots end to end, from brief to delivered assets.

Independent budget responsibility: builds production budgets, tracks them and delivers close to plan.

Established crew, studio, post and casting network in DACH.

Working knowledge of post-production workflow: edit, grade, retouch, versioning, delivery specs per channel.

Solid grasp of usage rights, buyouts, model and location releases and music licensing.

On-set and in-studio duty of care: working hours, equipment and rigging safety, electrical safety, rules for minors, insurance.

Experience with talent, models, agencies and creators, including riders and advancing.

Understanding of streetwear, fashion and music, and of the 6PM community.

Willingness to escalate and to stop a shoot on safety or feasibility grounds.

Experience running or working day to day in a studio environment, including booking, set-up and keeping it production-ready.

Hands-on equipment knowledge: camera systems, lenses, lighting and grip, audio and storage, plus what breaks and what it costs to fix.

German fluent, English confident.

Preferred

Has set up or scaled an in-house studio, including kit selection and workflow.

Experience producing content at live formats such as drops, pop-ups or shows.

E-commerce and product photography at volume.

Own shooting, editing, grading or retouching ability for fast turnarounds.

Experience with asset management systems and delivery pipelines.

Productions outside DACH.

Formal education is not a selection criterion. Assessment is based on delivered
productions.

Modern office in Berlin, complimentary drinks & work-from-home Fridays

Contribution towards a gym membership as well as various mobility benefits

Individual training and development opportunities to support your professional and personal growth

Regular team events and incentives

Flexible working hours based on trust within a motivated team

Attractive salary package with a variable compensation component

Want to be a part of 6PM? We'd love to hear from you!

At noew, we flipped that. Life isn’t a routine. It’s the early run, the deadline, the short night and the night out, sometimes all in the same week. We build for those moments. Our formulas meet your body when its need actually goes up, and our app reads your data so you know what you need before you even ask.

We just went live, out of Amsterdam, with Europe as our first market. A small team, a real product and a scientific board behind every formula. What we need now is the person who decides how all of it looks and feels.

One role, three titles

The work is the same: make noew look and feel like nothing else out there. Where you start depends on what you’ve done:
Allround creative: you’re a strong maker with a sharp eye
Art director: you’ve set the visual direction for a brand and led shoots
Creative director: you’ve built a brand’s creative from scratch and led a team

We level you on what you’ve done. You grow on what you build here.

What you’ll do

Set and guard noew’s art direction everywhere people meet us: social, ads, the app, the site and packaging
Turn the brand into a system others can build on: visual language, photo and video direction, templates
Concept and direct campaigns and shoots, from moodboard to final edit, and make a lot of it with your own hands
Brief and direct our graphic designers and creators, and keep raising the bar
Work side by side with our Head of Growth: you bring the ideas, growth tests them at volume, and together you learn what actually moves people
Own how our channels look and feel: Instagram and TikTok first, then LinkedIn and whatever platform earns its place

Hybrid, from our office in Amsterdam

Your portfolio

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

What if your next playground was to build a global, iconic Brand, with a creative machine that never sleeps, and compounds?

Then you’ll love this.

We’re not looking for a "Social Media Manager" to follow a calendar. We’re looking for an AI-native Creative Strategist (Brand & Content).

Someone who understands that to win today, you don’t just need "content", you need a Movement.

This isn’t another content job.
Most content teams use AI to write captions faster. That’s the 99%. We want to be in the 0.1%: a media where AI runs the creative loop, from the signal to the hook, the cut, the post and the lesson. Every day, on every platform, in French and in English. You bring the taste. The machine you build brings the scale.

Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. We aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents.

What Ai-native Content Means At Paradox 🤖

Paradoxically, the more AI runs our content, the more human it has to feel. AI doesn’t make more of what everyone makes. It makes more of what only we can make.

Our Creative Machine Has To Be Able To

Read the signals. Comments, DMs, retention graphs, saves, shares, search trends, objections from sales calls, and what the best creators and advertisers in the world are publishing right now.
Hold the full context of Paradox. Our DNA, years of interviews, lives and courses, member stories, and every past post with what it taught us, in one shared company brain.
Generate in our voice. Hooks, scripts, shorts, carousels, cuts, thumbnails and captions, in French and in English.
Ship. Format, schedule, publish and answer, on every platform.
Measure with real KPIs. Retention, shares, saves, follower growth, and the followers who become leads and members. Not likes.
Learn and loop on its own. Double down on what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content and wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.

OUR MISSION

At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable, and we believe self-help is broken.

Most learning platforms are used the same way: consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

People deserve more: a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We Do That By Merging

Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

Short history

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.

YOUR MISSION 🚀

You lead the Content Factory not by management, but with creativity.

Your goal is to produce content that is so good, unique, and aligned with our values that people would cry if they had to unsubscribe.

In a classic content team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the volume, you design the machine, set the bar and make the calls. Humans do what no machine can: taste.

🎯 YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS

Architect the "Dual-Brand" Strategy
Build a symbiotic strategy where David Laroche’s personal brand and Paradox’s company brand reinforce each other without cannibalization.
Implement radical new formats (documentaries, conceptual shorts) that shatter the boring codes of the "Self-Help" industry.
Define distinct, sharp editorial lines for each platform: Depth & Search for YouTube, Aesthetic & Vibe for Instagram, and Authority & Authenticity for LinkedIn.
❌ The old way: a strategy deck written once a year, and a calendar filled by habit.
🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents watch every platform, every competitor and every comment continuously. They tell you which angle is rising, which format is tiring and which story our audience asks for. The strategy updates every week, on evidence.
Radical Concepting & End-to-End Delivery
Take responsibility for the entire production chain from hooks to storyboarding the narrative, and ensuring the final cut matches the vision.
Own the packaging: titles, thumbnails and the first 3 seconds. You test variants every week and know your click-through and retention numbers by heart.
Deliver what you pitch.
❌ The old way: one shoot becomes one video and a handful of posts.
🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: one shoot, one live or one interview becomes dozens of hooks, shorts, carousels and ad cuts by the next morning, in both languages. Concepts are tested with AI-generated drafts before we spend a day shooting them.
Build the Content Factory: humans and agents
Your taste becomes the eval. You write down what makes a great hook, a great cut, a great carousel and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
Act as the final quality check: nothing gets published if it doesn’t meet the "Paradox Standard" of aesthetics and storytelling, whether a person or an agent made it.
❌ The old way: a creative team briefs an editor, waits three days and gets two versions.
🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents draft, cut, caption, translate and schedule. You keep the best, and next week their first drafts are already closer to your bar.
Fuel the Growth Engine
Analyze retention graphs, CTR, and CPL to iterate based on feedback, killing what fails and aggressively scaling what works.
❌ The old way: someone pulls the stats at the end of the month and nobody changes anything.
🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents read the numbers of every post every day, explain why it worked or didn’t, and propose the next test. You measure the machine itself: posts per week, time from idea to live, hit rate, and the share of the work done without a human.
Go global, and keep the soul
We started in French. You build the machine that takes Paradox to English-speaking audiences: channels, formats and voice that feel native, not translated.
And always: real stories told with consent, no fake claims, no fake scarcity. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.

How you’ll know you’re AI-native:
you spend your time on concepts, taste and calls, not on resizing, captioning and exporting. The output grows every month while the team doesn’t.

THE IDEAL AI NATIVE CANDIDATE 😍

Experience

Proven Content Builder: You have successfully grown a media brand, a YouTube channel, or a personal brand to significant scale (100k+ followers or millions of views). You understand the mechanics of virality and retention. You’ve created at least one format that broke out, and you can show its click-through and retention numbers.
Elite Scripting Skills: You can show us scripts you wrote that performed. You know how to structure a narrative, write a hook that stops the scroll, and keep an audience engaged for 20+ minutes.
Performance Fluency: You have worked in environments where content had to drive business results (ads, launches, conversion), not just vanity metrics.
AI-native Creative: you’ve built content pipelines with AI yourself: Claude Code, automations, generative video, image and voice tools, evals. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

Traits :

Intolerant to Mediocrity: You have "Taste." You are physically pained by a bad font, a clumsy cut, or a weak headline. You fight for the details that others ignore, including in what AI produces.
Psychology Obsessed: You don’t just "make content"; you study human nature. You constantly ask why people click, why they share, and what emotion drives them.
A "Doer" with Authority: You command respect not by title, but by competence. You can jump into a project, write the script, direct the shoot, and fix the edit if needed.
Loop thinker: you see every platform as a loop that can learn, and you can’t stop yourself from closing it.
No Ego, Just Impact: You don’t fall in love with your ideas. You accept that even the best concepts can flop. When it happens, you don’t take it personally; you analyze the data, pivot immediately, and ship the next concept with renewed energy.

Language

French: Native / Bilingual

English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU

❌ If you need clarity before chaos: wrong place.

❌ If you prefer balance over intensity: wrong season.

❌ If you don’t genuinely care about the topics we cover: wrong place.

❌ If you want to strategize without getting your hands dirty in scripting, directing, or the editing suite: wrong role.

❌ If you think AI content means generic content: wrong role. We use AI to multiply what only we can make.

❌ If you want to manage a large team: we’d rather build the machine than grow the headcount.

WHY JOIN US ❤️

Help us market a product that fuses neuroscience, design, and AI to reinvent how humans grow.

Build one of the first truly AI-native media, and write the playbook others will copy.

Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.

You’ll compete with San Francisco companies.

Growth & Ambition

> 🏅 Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform

Competitive Salary

But you don’t just want a competitive paycheck, you also want…

Impact & Meaning

> Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people
> Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something!

We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reached a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives.

But that’s not all, we believe that driven people deserve…

Freedom & Well Being 🗽

> 😎 A company culture based on autonomy & accountability
> 🗽 Flexible working hours (but very hard working)
> 🌎 A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want
> 🧍‍♀️ Standing desks paid by the company if you live far from our offices
> 💻 Work on Mac, for us it counts :)
> 🏀 350€ per year paid by the company to take care of yourself (for your gym, or dance class or whatever make you feel great)
> 📚 150€ of books or education - At Paradox, we are learner lovers and we want to support you in that
> 🔥 Access to Athena - our Paradox AI Coach supporting you on anything personal or professional, we want you to live your best life

How To Apply 📃

⚠️ To complete the recruitment process, each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this : do not apply ⚠️

If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us 🚀🚀🚀🚀

HIRING PROCESS 📃

That job description resonated with you?

Here is your tailor made hiring process

📃 A 6 to 8 minutes application survey, with links to content you made and something you built with AI

💻 A 30mn video call with Timy, HR, to deep dive into your career path and ambitions

💻 A 1h video call, to discuss how you’d fit into Paradox’s content team

💻 A 1h culture-fit video call, to assess alignment with our values and mindset

💻 A 1h final video call with David, CEO, to discuss the creative vision and the next milestones to build

💼 Reference check to understand how you operate across environments and help set you up for a smooth onboarding

🫵🚀 Welcome

Concept, design (art), and execute innovative ad campaigns and experiences for global brands.

Partner with designers, program managers, developers, strategists, business leads, and producers to create customer-focused solutions that deliver on advertiser objectives.

Independently lead campaigns from brief to execution and collaborate with internal teams, clients, and external agency partners.
Obsessed with understanding customers and making work that delivers both innovation and results.
Present ideas and concepts to clients, agencies, and internally.
Proven ability to ideate for film, print, digital, out-of-home, experiential, and social.
Ability to manage multiple projects at once within budget and deadlines.
Be proactive in developing new products and ideas on behalf of the customer.

Partnering with a variety of brands, media, and creative agencies to work on innovative campaigns for travel and tourism, automotive, finance, consumables, telecommunication etc.
From designing brand experiences (digital and physical), from documentary films in Prime Video to Alexa branded experiences, you will always strive to create never-before-done ideas.
Presenting a campaign to senior brand clients and their partners in creative and media agencies.
Reviewing edits and work in progress with your partners, collecting and responding to feedback in order to meet the highest creative standards.
Work with your team on proactive projects and initiatives and bring them to life.

The Brand Innovation Lab is Amazon' Ads Innovation team dedicated to creating one-of-a-kind campaigns and activations for global advertisers.

Leveraging the full Amazon canvas: custom landing pages, Alexa, Fire TV, Twitch, Prime Video, and more. We build campaigns that reach millions of customers across digital channels and in the real world.

The team also works on Prime Video IP and brands, developing co-branded full-funnel campaigns.

Experience in driving compelling creative strategy and execution at an agency or in-house creative team
Experience communicating and delivering presentations to customers, stakeholders, and/or teammates
In-depth understanding of industry design tools (Ex. Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma), and a basic understanding of UX design and UX design Tools (ie. Webflow)

Knowledge of InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator, Keynote
Experience developing cross-functional relationships with product, consumer research and marketing teams to develop strategy and consumer insights that drive compelling creative executions
Experience leading creative development of innovative creative from concept to delivery
Experience presenting creative concepts effectively to senior executives

Experience in developing creative concepts and executing campaigns for brand partnerships and/or sponsorships

Lead the creative engine: Own the creative system from commercial objective and concept through to variants, live testing and scaled production, creating a model that delivers quality creative at speed and volume.

ChillBase studio is an independent and innovative player in the gaming industry. We’re fueled by our passion for crafting outstanding products.

We’re creating OneState, a mobile life simulator built in Unity. Our art team is facing ambitious challenges as we develop the project with a realistic approach and high standards for visual quality and technical solutions.

We use modern technologies and tools, continuously refining our pipelines and aiming for the highest level of quality and immersion. We are looking for a Creative Director who will partner closely with the CCO and own the creative meaning of the product: narrative, atmosphere, audio vision, creative design, and brand.

If you are seeking to be a part of an engaged team, work on captivating projects with minimal bureaucracy, and receive regular, constructive feedback, then you’ll find your place with us.

Apply now

Apply now

Expectations

What we want to see

Experience as a Creative Director / Head of Creative in gaming
Proven track record of shaping long-term creative vision for a product or IP
Deep understanding of how sound, atmosphere, and emotion shape player experience
Experience working with cross-functional teams (Art, Production, Brand)
Ability to operate at director/producer level as a strategic partner
Strong systems thinking and experience building autonomous teams
Strong cultural awareness and visual literacy
Strategic mindset
Ability to articulate, defend, and adapt creative decisions
Partnership-driven leadership style (not hierarchy-driven)
Focus on long-term product value

What you will be doing

Define and sustain a cohesive creative vision for the product
Own and oversee:
Narrative and atmosphere
Creative design
Sound and music (audio vision)
Brand identity and tone of voice
Partner with the Art Director to ensure a unified product vibe
Contribute to product and IP strategy at the leadership level
Build and scale an autonomous creative unit across:
Narrative
Audio
Brand
Content
Mentor and grow strong discipline leads
Balance creative decisions through a value / impact / cost lens

Benefits

Growth and development

Our project is actively growing, as well as the team that creates it. We invest in the growth of each specialist and regularly review salaries based on performance. Moreover, we have a promotion system that allows specialists to showcase their talents in more responsible positions.

Comfortable conditions

You can choose various work types (fully remote, hybrid, office). Also we have flexible hours with the option of taking days off.

Care for employees

We offer sick days without salary loss, assistance in difficult life situations, no bureaucratic nightmares and processes for the sake of processes.

Relocation assistance

If you’re ready to join the team in Dubai, we will help you make it happen.

Employment

We offer an employment system, including official labor relations in Dubai.

Employment process

You apply for an open role via our careers portal. We carefully review your CV and any additional materials you provide.

If your experience matches our needs, we’ll invite you for an initial conversation with a recruiter. It’s a chance to get to know each other, talk about your motivation and expectations, and share more about the role and company.

You may be asked to take part in one or more technical interviews with the team. In some cases, we might also send you a test assignment to better understand your practical skills.

A closing conversation with a hiring manager or team lead. We’ll discuss the outcomes of the previous stages, cover any remaining questions, and align on expectations.

If everything goes well — we’ll extend a job offer. Once the details are confirmed, we’ll guide you through the onboarding process and welcome you to the team.

new_jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for an experienced Creative Lead
to join the Stumble Guys team at Flamed, Scopely’s in-house creative agency, in Barcelona on a hybrid basis.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day. We are a global team developing, publishing and innovating in the games industry, connecting millions of people around the world.

We are Flamed, the in-house creative agency, an international multidisciplinary team. We produce thousands of creatives each year to support the global marketing needs of all Scopely games.

What You Will Do

Stumble Guys brings millions of players together for chaotic multiplayer races, absurd obstacles and hilarious fails. Our creative work should capture that same energy and humour.

We are looking for a creative leader with proven experience in mobile user acquisition and organic social content, strong creative judgment and a clear understanding of Gen Alpha’s gaming culture, creators, humor and content habits.

Reporting to the Senior Creative Director, you will develop creative concepts for UA, organic and reengagement, informed by performance insights, marketing strategy and relevant trends. You will partner closely with UA, Marketing and production leads to bring those ideas to life, tailoring the storytelling, formats and language to each audience and channel.

Lead research, benchmarking and brainstorms to develop creative concepts for UA, organic and reengagement, informed by marketing objectives, performance insights, audience motivations and relevant trends.
Partner with Marketing, Project Managers and Producers on creative roadmaps, aligning with game updates, events and collaborations, and agreeing realistic priorities, scope and timelines.
Develop creative testing roadmaps with UA partners, defining hypotheses, prioritising new concepts and iterations, and identifying the questions each test should answer.
Develop and present clear pitches and decks, scripts and storyboards, explaining the creative rationale and adapting storytelling, hooks and visual direction to each audience and channel.
Create clear, actionable production briefs and handovers in close partnership with the Arts and Animation team, our production powerhouse, communicating the concept, creative intent, audience and channel requirements. Provide creative input and clarification when consulted during production.
Work with UA, Marketing and Creative Intelligence partners to interpret asset performance, share actionable learnings and improve future concepts and tests.
Partner with Social and Community teams to develop recurring organic formats and content ideas informed by audience behaviour, community feedback and platform trends.
Use AI throughout your workflow to support research, work organisation, performance analysis and roadmap planning, continually identifying practical ways to improve speed and effectiveness.

What We Are Looking For

A strong background in advertising, creative strategy or creative direction, with demonstrated experience leading creative work for mobile products.
Proven experience developing creative for both performance marketing / user acquisition and organic social content, with a clear understanding of their different objectives and measures of success.
Strong understanding of Gen Alpha’s gaming and entertainment culture, including creators, humour, storytelling and platform conventions, with concrete examples of how this informs your creative decisions.
Strong organisation and prioritisation skills, with experience partnering on creative and testing roadmaps and aligning work with marketing calendars and production plans.
Strong concept development and storytelling skills, with an eye for hooks, pacing, visual clarity and the details that make short-form content effective.
Confidence working with UA KPIs and creative dashboards, translating performance data into hypotheses and actionable creative decisions.
Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and external partners through clear briefs, effective handovers and constructive creative input.
Practical understanding of video, gameplay capture, animation and design workflows, sufficient to assess feasibility, brief specialists and collaborate effectively with production partners.
An AI-first approach to work, with demonstrated experience integrating AI tools into everyday workflows, including organisation, research, analysis and planning, and sound judgment when assessing their outputs.
Excellent communication and presentation skills in English, with the ability to explain your thinking, align stakeholders and drive decisions.

Bonus Point

Experience in mobile gaming or entertainment.
Experience creating campaigns or ongoing content for Gen Alpha or other young audiences.
Experience collaborating with creators or developing content inspired by creator formats.

Please include a portfolio, reel or case studies showing both UA and organic social work. Alongside the final assets, explain your contribution, the strategy behind the work, and the results or learnings that informed your next decisions.

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice.
